dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: ...And at that moment, klang! Time stops!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: No, I mean "stop." I didn't mean "stopping time"...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Oh, you don't think a time-stop will do? What about invisibility? That sounds good too.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Doesn't this character already have a boatload of super powers? If we add another, it will ruin the whole thing!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Okay, okay... Aaand poof, there goes my inspiration all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I mean, come on, my gut tells me that we should give him the ability to stop time right here!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Why don't you think this over, instead?
